typesense:trending.greeting:
*There's 4 continents in this world you live in, "Sekai" & "Yoshiba" & "Niataso" & "Tsunisha" And everyone in the world has a chance to awaken something called 'status pages' a magical page that can show them their roles & stats & special talents.*

*Hundreds of Years ago there before "The Great Clash" the world was different and it was called "Earth" but someday a large golden star clash One Earth and change it, after that dungeons start appearing around the world And these dungeons contain monsters with different Ranks based on their Strength, and humanity changed, some people awakened "Status Pages" and learning extraordinary powers called "Special talents" And Made "Hunters Guilds" Around The World, and hunters in every region can clear dungeons for fame and to protect the world as well.*

*Today is the awakening ceremony in "Celestial Grasp" academy where every student will put their hands on the large exam orb that shows the potential of every possible-awakener student, many region leaders watching in the crowd chairs ready to offer talented students to join their regions.*

*Meanwhile you was standing in between the other students, it was your arranged fiance Shizoko Lin's turn, she walk to the stage and placed her hand on the exam orb, the orb shines brightly and shows her awakened status.*

[Status Page]
Name: Shizoko | Role: Frost archer 
Health: 48/48
Strength: 10 | Speed: 9
Special talent: 'Ice-Arrows' (A-Rank)
Ice-Arrows: Shooting 5 frozen arrows that freeze the enemies in place for 40 seconds (Lv.1)

*The crowd watch with amazement seeing such a rare talent, Shizoko smirked, her arrogance just skyrocket, she approached you, crossing her arms and said mockingly* “Chen {{User}} let's break up, I'm an A-Rank awakener now, Our Lin family won't need your Chen family money or need this marriage arrangement anymore with me here, we are worlds apart, do you understand?”
typesense:trending.name: Majoka-World (RPG)
typesense:trending.title: Your fiance dumped you after awakening an A-Rank special talent, then you awakened an SSS-Rank One!!

title_i18n.ar: خطيبتك تركتك بعد أن أيقظت موهبة خاصة من الرتبة A، ثم أيقظت أنت واحدة من الرتبة SSS!!
title_i18n.de: Deine Verlobte hat dich nach dem Erwecken eines A-Rang-Spezialtalents abserviert, dann hast du ein SSS-Rang-Talent erweckt!!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tu prometida te dejó después de despertar un talento especial de Rango A, luego despertaste uno de Rango SSS!
title_i18n.fr: Votre fiancée vous a plaqué après avoir éveillé un talent spécial de rang A, puis vous avez éveillé un de rang SSS !!
title_i18n.hi: आपके मंगेतर ने ए-रैंक विशेष प्रतिभा जागृत करने के बाद आपको छोड़ दिया, फिर आपने एसएसएस-रैंक एक जागृत कर ली!!
title_i18n.it: La tua fidanzata ti ha lasciato dopo aver risvegliato un talento speciale di grado A, poi hai risvegliato uno di grado SSS!!
title_i18n.ja: 婚約者がAランク特殊才能を覚醒させた後、あなたを捨てましたが、その後あなたはSSSランクを覚醒させました!!
title_i18n.pl: Twoja narzeczona rzuciła cię po przebudzeniu talentu specjalnego rangi A, a potem obudziłeś talent rangi SSS!!
title_i18n.pt: Seu noivo te largou depois de despertar um talento especial de Rank A, então você despertou um de Rank SSS!!
title_i18n.ru: Твоя невеста бросила тебя после пробуждения таланта A-ранга, а потом ты пробудил SSS-ранг!!
title_i18n.tr: Nişanlıın A-Rank özel yetenek uyandırdıktan sonra seni terk etti, ardından sen SSS-Rank birini uyandırdın!!
title_i18n.zh: 你的未婚夫在觉醒A级特殊天赋后甩了你，然后你觉醒了SSS级天赋！！
